judgment: I opened this Book of Life and Death and examined it — on every crooked page were the four words ”destined by Heaven”. I could not sleep, and read carefully into the night until, between the lines, I made out the words — the whole book was filled with two words: ”eat people”!
svg_description: Lu Xun stands in the Hall of Yama, glaring coldly at the Book of Life and Death line art

judgment: He writes to Wu Cheng'en to correct the Song-dynasty porcelain vase at a demon king's banquet (it did not exist in the Tang dynasty), and to CCTV director Yang Jie to illustrate that a ”Yikouzhong” is a cloak — two humorous ”correction letters” as postcards.
